title: adonis autumnalis var. baetica
intro: Adonis autumnalis var. baetica, commonly known as Autumn Crocus, is a plant species within the Paeoniaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, pain, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Autumn Crocus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help relieve symptoms associated with coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of Autumn Crocus include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
